findings.evidence: Folding/Eigenspaces.lean:45 `def typeDGraphSplit : (((Unit ⊕ (I ⊕ I)) → A) × A) ≃ₗ[A] ((Option I ⊕ Option I) → A)`, with toFun `p.1 (.inl ()) ± p.2` and invFun `⅟2 * (v inl ± v inr)`. These are exactly the PR's inclusion/anti-inclusion and averaging projections. Its docstring at :22-23 says it retains the scalar factors needed to restrict skew-adjoint endomorphisms to the fixed space.
findings.fix: Define the coordinate maps from `typeDGraphSplit` (e.g. `LinearMap.toMatrix'` of `typeDGraphSplit ∘ₗ LinearMap.inl`/`inr` and of the components of its `symm`). Transport along `Equiv.optionSubtypeNe c` (Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Option.lean), or build the fixed-algebra equivalence at `none : Option I` and reach `Fin.last m` through `finSuccEquivLast`.
findings.issue: `typeDGraphInclusion`, `typeDGraphAntiInclusion`, `typeDGraphProjection` and `typeDGraphAntiProjection` are the matrices of the existing `TauCeti.typeDGraphSplit` (restricted to the `.1` and `.2` factors) and of its inverse. They differ only in indexing the distinguished pair by `c` with complement `{i // i ≠ c}` instead of by `none` with complement `I`.

findings.fix: Derive the three matrix identities from `typeDGraphSplit_bilin` (via `Matrix.toBilin'` and `LinearMap.toMatrix₂'`) once the coordinate matrices come from `typeDGraphSplit`.

findings.issue: `typeDGraphProjection_mul_inclusion`, `typeDGraphProjection_mul_antiInclusion`, `typeDGraphAntiProjection_mul_inclusion`, `typeDGraphAntiProjection_mul_antiInclusion` and `typeDGraphInclusion_mul_projection_add` restate the two inverse laws of `typeDGraphSplit`. `typeDGraphMatrix_mul_inclusion` and `typeDGraphMatrix_mul_antiInclusion` restate `typeDGraphSplit_graphIndex`. summary: Coordinates.lean rebuilds, as hand-coded matrices with their own case-split proofs, the type-D graph split already provided by `typeDGraphSplit` in TypeD/Folding/Eigenspaces.lean (inverse laws, swap action, Gram decomposition); the author's reply fixes the other reuse findings but does not address this one.
